body:
- `better-auth-rs generate --help` lists `username, two-factor, device-authorization, api-key, admin, organization, passkey`, but the registry also provides `anonymous, phone-number, last-login-method, jwt, siwe, organization-teams, organization-dynamic-roles`.
- `--plugins nonsense` exits 0 and emits the core schema with no warning, so a typo silently drops columns/tables.

**Expected:** generate the help text from `registry::plugin_schemas()` and fail (non-zero) on unknown plugin names.
title: CLI: stale --help plugin list; unknown --plugins names are silently ignored
